blocks.html: Any saved recording can be replayed in the Timeline Viewer.

slides.title: Open & play a recording
slides.html:
Select Open next to a filename to open the Timeline Viewer at the bottom of the map.

  • It shows the start/end and total time, player speed, current and elapsed time, and a green mark for each event.
  • Chats sent or received during the recording appear in a panel beside the viewer.
  • Select Play to start; only events inside the recording region display, at the point in time they occurred.

slides.title: Control playback speed
slides.html: Each press of fast-forward or reverse changes the speed up to 64x or down to −64x; a negative speed plays backwards toward the start. Tick Pan to Map Events (off by default) to keep replayed events in view as they play.
